practicalCriteria: Every one of the 19 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
Each price line shows a unit, a quantity, a rate and the GST position, and the total equals the sum of the lines less any offer
Each reference row has a recorded consent date and names only the topics the person agreed to
Each product or environmental claim names an evidence item the client can request, or the claim has been deleted
Inclusions, exclusions and the complaint route match the client service agreement (TPL-13) and the quote terms (TPL-04)
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: not applicable: document-only lesson, no field work
